title: TV home screen
brief: The owner's own smart-TV home screen on the living-room TV in /world, shown after clicking the TV: apps Movies & Series, Games (Ghost of Tsushima featured as his favourite), My videos (Carneros DC #32 clip), Channels (official YouTube embed), Anime, Highlights (NFL / Jordan) and Lo-fi radio; covers drawn as stylized placeholders, sample rows labeled for replacement. Original identity, not a streaming-service copy.

artboards.title: Full-screen TV OS
artboards.tradeoff: Most readable and remote-like (arrow-key focus ring, big hero with the note, app dock + cover rows); hides the room entirely, so it feels like leaving the 3D world

artboards.title: On the TV panel (diegetic)
artboards.tradeoff: Strongest immersion: the UI lives on the 16:9 panel inside the room with a small side caption; text is small (12px floor) and needs a precise camera framing on the panel

artboards.title: Split: TV playing + console card
artboards.tradeoff: Matches the katana/case story cards and keeps the TV playing (lo-fi visualizer); the card is the only browsing surface, so fewer covers fit (8 per app) and covers are small
